title: Feuille de route chiffrée des investissements en santé numérique
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention
why_not: Costs a hospital information system (SIH) for 16 provincial hospitals and 86 HGR and a health-centre system (SICS) for 150 centres over three years, but nowhere says either holds the clinical record; on HMIS it states nothing on tiers, place of entry or clinics, and the plan gap there is already held.
